rows.claim: In general, people call on the one true Lord in real need, then attribute the granted blessing to other means once their need is fulfilled.

rows.claim: Even Pharaoh called on God while drowning, showing that exceptions do not negate the general pattern of people turning to God in real need.
rows.anchor: Nevertheless, exceptions do not nullify this rule.
